CA.rationale: Candidate content and its origin/processing condition are explicitly paired in the same candidate record.

COD.rationale: A content entry (red) is given alongside explicit origin/organization metadata for the same current referent, with separate status-like fields.

A.rationale: Candidate-record origin fields (including executed_branch_claim) explicitly link a processing condition to the candidate content's organization.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content assignments (color at coordinates) identify represented content and attributes.

D.rationale: Content entries are given separately from origin/organization metadata, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Records explicitly state how content is represented/emerges (current vs candidate origins and represented_time), i.e. presentation/access organization.
